# Cleaning Laboratory Devices

This is the original cleaning procedure for shared laboratory devices.

## Centrifuge Cleaning

After each run, wipe the centrifuge rotor and chamber down with a cloth
dampened in 70% ethanol. Allow the surfaces to air dry for at least four
working hours before the next booking so residual solvent fully evaporates.
Log the cleaning in the shared maintenance sheet.
